title: Promotion queue entry
description: An entry of the tenant's promotion queue (GOV-14): one entry per bot, without expiry and without a length ceiling, ordered by trigger_at. Only the governance loop writes it.

trigger_proposal.description: The proposal that gave the trigger.

trigger_at.description: When the trigger appeared; the queue order.

state.description: queued: waits for its turn; waiting_eligibility: failed eligibility at opening and lets the next go ahead; in_case: a case is open for it; removed: left the queue.

cooldown_until.description: The entry's own swap_cooldown after its first wrong_candidate (D-101); until then the next entries may go ahead.

wrong_candidate_count.description: How many "Reject" with wrong_candidate this entry got.

removed_reason.description: Why the entry left the queue; from v0.3 parked when its bot left a seat for a confirmed link and was parked (GOV-42).
